title: The Duke of East Nashville
description:
Welcome to The Duke of East Nashville! You will feel like royalty in this newly built townhome, conveniently located just a short distance from Broadway, Germantown, and Five Points, along with easy highway accessibility. Feel relaxed, secure, and comfortable behind the walls of this gated community!

The space
This two-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bathroom home is perfect for the entire family. The home includes free off-street parking, a third-floor balcony with neighborhood views, a private workspace with a desk and desk chair, and a fully equipped kitchen with modern, stainless steel appliances.

The space was designed and built with you, the guest, in mind. Modern, luxurious, but simple. The first floor features an open-concept living, with a fully appointed kitchen and breakfast bar that seats three people, along with three additional dining spaces located behind the living room couch.  There is high-speed WiFi and smart TV to connect to all your favorite streaming services, as well as a convenient half bathroom on the first floor.

On the second floor, guests will find a massive bedroom with plenty of room to spare. A large en suite bathroom with a walk-in shower gives extra room for getting ready. Also on this level is a laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer, to which you will have full access. 

The third floor includes the second private bedroom and en suite bathroom with a tub/shower combo. The third-floor landing includes a large desk, perfect for getting ready or catching up on work. From here, you may also access the third-floor balcony, which includes seating and tables. Perfect relaxing spot for a morning cup of coffee!

Other things to note
*Please note: this is a smoke-free, pet-free establishment. If you are looking to book a party, please check other available listings!
